info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Debug Snapshots API
Google Cloud Dataflow Snapshot a Dataflow job in a project

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Dataflow job.

items.docs: Creates a snapshot of a streaming Dataflow job in the specified project. Snapshots capture the state of a streaming pipeline and can be used to start a new job from that state.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Snapshot a Dataflow job in a specific location

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Dataflow job.

items.docs: Creates a snapshot of a streaming Dataflow job in the specified project and regional location. Snapshots capture the state of a streaming pipeline and can be used to start a new job from that state.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Get a snapshot in a specific location

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

params.name: snapshotId
params.description: The ID of the snapshot to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a specified snapshot in the given project and regional location. Returns the snapshot metadata including state, creation time, and associated job information.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Delete a snapshot in a specific location

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

params.name: snapshotId
params.description: The ID of the snapshot to delete.

items.docs: Deletes a specified snapshot in the given project and regional location. This permanently removes the snapshot and its associated data.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow List snapshots in a specific location

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

params.name: jobId
params.description: If specified, list snapshots created from this job only.

items.docs: Lists all available snapshots in the specified project and regional location. Returns snapshot metadata including state, creation time, and associated job information.
